text: On December 19, 2017 a Zoning By-law Amendment application (Application No. 17 277456 ESC 38 OZ) along with a Draft Plan of Subdivision Application (Application No. 17 277479 ESC 38 SB) were submitted to permit the redevelopment of the lands with seven tall, residential buildings ranging in height from 14 to 48 storeys and twelve four-storey back-to-back townhouse blocks with a total of 2,245 residential units. The proposed buildings would be spread out over 5 development blocks with a centrally located public park being its own block. Two public streets are proposed within the site, along with one private street.
